newsitem.title: UK: UK govt aims for high growth, employment levels.
newsitem.headline: UK govt aims for high growth, employment levels.

text.p: Britain's new Labour government on Wednesday pledged to work for high, stable levels of growth and employment, and to ensure public borrowing is controlled by tough fiscal rules.
The promises were made in the speech in which Queen Elizabeth formally opened the new session of parliament following the May 1 election.

The speech, written for the Queen by cabinet ministers, said: "The central economic objectives of my Government are high and stable levels of economic growth and employment, to be achieved by ensuring opportunity for all."
"The essential platform for achieving these objectives is economic stability," the speech added.
It said that was why the Government would introduce a bill to give the Bank of England operational responsibility for setting interest rates.
"My Government will also ensure that public borrowing is controlled through tough fiscal rules, and that the burden of public debt os kept at a stable and prudent level," the Queen said.
She said the Government, in aiming to deliver high and sustainable growth and jobs levels, would encourage investment in industry, skills, infrastructure and new technologies.
It would try to reduce long-term unemployment especially among the young, promote competition and help to create successful and profitable business.
"These policies will enhance Britain's position as a leading industrial nation," the Queen said.

She confirmed that the government planned an early budget which would feature a windfall levy "on the excess profits of the privatised utilities" to tackle youth and long-term unemployment. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
